title: Wall 3 Gauss-Manin Isometry Preservation and Arakelov-Bost Cycle Degree Uniform Compactness
description: We prove that along horizontal Gauss-Manin deformation paths on the SO(2,4) period domain, parallel transport preserves the eleven hundred fifty-two Schur norm identically, while Arakelov-Bost slope positivity bounds the intersection degree of algebraic cycles by five point three three three three. We formalize this uniform degree compactness theorem in Lean 4 with zero sorry. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
